result:
Round 88 failed at C on an old keyboard bug, so round 89 is a fix-only round for that bug. The decision is **CONTINUE**. I changed no app source: `git status` still shows the same 18 lines and all 506 frozen files are unchanged. The advisor was available and I consulted it twice, before writing and before finishing.

**What C found in round 88** (browser-checked at both viewports)
- **The progress bug is fixed by C's evidence.** The new sticky footer keeps the status, progress bar and busy button visible in every export phase at 1280×720 and 1440×900. The worst frame gap during a 5-minute WAV export fell to 55.2 ms.
- **New medium bug, R88-FOCUS-ESCAPE-RENDER.** During an export with WAV (the default) or MP3 selected, the third Tab leaves the Export dialog. Focus moves to the page behind it: first `BODY`, then the exit link, then Master Mute and Master Volume.
  - **It is older than round 88.** The trap code is identical in the published `971141d`.
  - **Cause, confirmed in the source:** the trap wraps only when focus is on the last control. During an export that last control is the "WAV + MP3" radio. The browser treats a radio group as a single Tab stop, so Tab from the selected WAV or MP3 radio skips the trap and leaves the dialog.
- Gate 88 was skipped, so rounds 87–88 are still uncommitted on top of `971141d`.

**Round 89 task (`current-task.md`, decision D-29z54)**
- **Fix:** a new helper module, `app/lib/arrangement/dialog-tab-stops.ts`, that counts each radio group as one Tab stop. The dialog's Tab handler then wraps on the first and last stop: Tab from the format group goes back to X, and Shift+Tab from X lands on the selected radio. Tabs in the middle stay native, which the frozen tests require.
- **Files A may change:** the new module, `ArrangementExportDialog.tsx` (one import and the Tab handler body), a new test file `export-dialog-tab-stops.test.tsx`, and doc 077 (status line plus three additions). Four files, so the code-reviewer is required.
- **Tests:** 8 tests (TS1–TS2, TR1–TR6), each tied to a mutation (a–f) that must turn it red.
- **Expected end state:** 7 M + 13 ??. A frozen list of 506 files guards everything else.
- **Rejected options:**
  - Disabling the format radios during an export would contradict D-29z52 and break a frozen test.
  - A focus-out guard would misfire on Alt-Tab.
  - Handling every Tab in code breaks the frozen tests.
- **C checks, both viewports, each on a fresh page:**
  - **Trap during an export:** TRAP-WAV (main check), TRAP-MP3, TRAP-BOTH (1440 only).
  - **Keyboard order:** PX-KEYS-R2 (C's exact round-88 failure recipe), IDLE-ORDER, FOCUS-NOT-OBSCURED-R.
  - **Footer sanity:** VIS-RENDER-S (1280).
  - **Network, console, purchase protection and source checks:** PX-NET, REG-HYD, G89-3, T89-TARGETED, SOURCE-UNCHANGED.
  - A new rule, HR-RENDERING, counts a key press only while the busy button shows the export is still running. It is now recorded in the backlog.
- **One contract choice of my own:** during an export, Shift+Tab from X lands on the selected format radio rather than "WAV + MP3", matching where the browser itself would land. No frozen test defines this.

**Planning files I updated (all mine)**
- `tasks/round-88.md` is an exact copy of the old task.
- `backlog.json` (evidence only):
  - the progress bug is marked passed by C but awaiting publication;
  - SRW-20 stage 3a stays not done;
  - new entries: R88-FOCUS-ESCAPE-RENDER, GATE-88-SKIPPED, A-R88-REVIEW-EDGES (Low batch), one info observation, and a Tech Lead real-keyboard check R88-T.
- Also updated: `feature-status.md`, `plan.md` (D-29z54), `b-round-88.md`, `b-next.json`, the new frozen list `b-round-88-r89-tree-sha256.txt` and the snapshot folder `b-round-88-r89-snapshots/`.
- Nothing was marked მზადაა.
- **Architecture:** the round-88 reviewer suggested pulling the dialog's focus code into a `useExportDialogFocus` hook if another focus issue landed there. Round 89 meets that condition. I added it to the pending checkpoint request (`b-round-83-checkpoint-request.md`, question 14) rather than refactoring in a bug-fix round. Root still hasn't answered that request; it doesn't block anything.

**After round 89**
- If C passes, root can publish rounds 87–89 together.
- I asked root again to check MP3 export in the production bundle at gate 89; it has never been verified there.
- Round 90 is the regression round if it is planned on or after 2026-10-24. Otherwise it is SRW-20 stage 3b (Cancel).
- Then the Low batch, SRW-21, full regression, T12 and VISUAL-A. Scope is unchanged and nothing is deferred.
